content: FlClash architecture (chen08209 + DeepWiki + wyusgw fork docs): Flutter UI + Riverpod + Material 3; desktop runs core as a separate process, Dart talks over IPC — Unix domain socket on Linux/macOS, named pipe on Windows; JSON envelope CoreMethodCall/CoreMethodResponse with request ids; new rust_api plugin uses flutter_rust_bridge 2.13.0 for a thin Rust helper (IPC server, hotkeys, tray); Android uses method channels to embedded library. Same core+IPC shape dicta already has.
